item.title: CVE-2025-54309
item.description: CrushFTP versions 10 prior to 10.8.5 and 11 before 11.3.4_23 have a critical vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to gain unauthorized admin access through HTTPS if the DMZ proxy feature is not used. A patch is available, so it is essential to update to the latest versions immediately to protect your systems. Ensure that this update is prioritized to mitigate any potential risks to hospital operations.

item.title: CVE-2025-54948
item.description: A critical vulnerability has been found in the Trend Micro Apex One management console that allows attackers to execute malicious code remotely. A patch is available, and it is strongly recommended to apply it immediately to protect your system. This will help avert unauthorized access and potential damage to hospital data.
